mechanism: Ampicillin and gentamicin exhibit synergistic bactericidal activity against gram-positive and some gram-negative organisms, but ampicillin may inactivate gentamicin in vitro and in vivo, particularly in patients with renal impairment.
action: Administer ampicillin and gentamicin separately; monitor serum gentamicin levels closely, ensure adequate renal function monitoring, and consider alternative agents if renal dysfunction develops during concurrent therapy.
